authentication_and_rbac.authorization_rule: Authenticated Google users without an authorised Firestore user profile are denied access.
authentication_and_rbac.role_resolution: Google identity → Firestore user profile lookup → role and department loaded from Firestore document.

roles.description: Full access. Can run controls, generate and approve CFO Financial Reviews, manage data.
Can run controls, generate reviews, upload data, manage billing and exceptions.
Read-only institutional access. Can update departmental billing review status for their assigned department.
Read-only access to audit logs and approved reports.

bootstrap_allowlist.purpose: Initial deployment bootstrap when application domain is not yet in Firebase Authorized Domains. Governed by Firestore profile; cannot grant privileges independently.

synthetic_data_isolation.policy: syntheticDataset.ts is a development/UAT fixture only and is not automatically loaded into production.
synthetic_data_isolation.production_state: Fresh production workspace begins completely empty. All financial figures derive strictly from user-imported Firestore records.

scope_and_terminology.definition: The application is a financial-control and revenue intelligence layer only. It never exercises clinical authority or patient release control.
scope_and_terminology.departmental_review: Departmental Billing Review: financial review and billing completeness associated with discharged encounters, not patient-release control.

financial_control_engine.rule: AI NEVER calculates financial values. All amounts from deterministic engine.
controls: C01 - Unbilled Service: Services delivered without corresponding billing line
C02 - Qty Mismatch: Quantity mismatch between services and billing
C03 - Amount Mismatch: Billed amount deviates from contracted tariff
C04 - Post-Billing Svc: Service entered after initial bill generation
C05 - Missing Final Bill: Discharged encounters with unfinalized or provisional bills
C06 - TPA Shortfall: Insurance disallowances and adjudication shortfalls
C07 - Overdue Receivables: Outstanding receivables exceeding settlement terms
C08 - Unusual Discount: Concession or discount above authorised limits

multi_agent_orchestrator.stage_lifecycle: PENDING → RUNNING → COMPLETED | SKIPPED | NO_DATA | ERROR
